items: Submit support tickets, review your previous requests, and open ticket details from your account.
Superadmins can filter incoming tickets, review their details, and update their triage status and notes.
New Privacy and Terms pages, footer links, and contact information make legal and support details easier to find.
Ticket access is scoped so users can view their own submissions while superadmins can manage all tickets.
Calendar feed links can now be revoked, and revoked links return a not-found response.
Calendar feed links use persisted, time-limited tokens with stronger tampering checks.
Navigation now includes Tickets, while refreshed layouts, typography, and administrative screens improve readability and consistency.
Magic-link emails now use configured contact and privacy addresses for sender and reply-to details.
